professional_participation_evidence.fixture: Brisbane Roar 0-1 Perth Glory, A-League Men, 2024-12-21
professional_participation_evidence.participation: Official report lists number 18 Jacob Brazete substituted on at 67 minutes; vendor metadata id 965698 is matched to shot event 8_871.
professional_participation_evidence.scope: Professional match participation; not a certification of optimal instep form or maximal power.

quality_policy.status: Exploratory feature screening, not an externally calibrated acceptance standard. Availability and quality masks remain separate.

uncertainty.interpretation: Vendor predicted p90 values are used as isotropic radial sensitivity budgets only. The source also calls them p90 MAE; no independent calibration or simultaneous coverage is supplied.
uncertainty.relative_position: sum of joint and midHip budgets; identical midHip variable cancels to zero.
uncertainty.segment_direction: For radius e smaller than vector length L, unit-direction budget is 2*sin(asin(e/L)/2); else 2. Conditional on endpoint errors lying inside assumed radial budgets.
uncertainty.relation_cosine: min(2, direction_budget_A + direction_budget_B), no independence assumption.
uncertainty.normalizer: Median of selected mean bilateral chain lengths; lower/upper medians propagate summed endpoint budgets with fixed eligibility.
uncertainty.claim_limit: These operations do not turn marginal predicted p90 values into a joint 90% bound or an independently measured uncertainty distribution.

field_semantics.joints_reconstructed_m: Unchanged vendor xyz values in metres, no smoothing/filling. x/y use pitch axes; z is reliable relative to player centroid only, not elevation above pitch.
field_semantics.joint_predicted_p90_cm/m: Source predicted error preserved in cm and explicitly divided by 100 for m.
field_semantics.joint_present/geometry_valid/error_valid: Separate schema presence, finite geometry, finite nonnegative error, and configured quality screen.
field_semantics.player_is_detected: Vendor player-screen detection flag, not per-joint visibility. Flag availability retained separately; false/missing never erases available geometry.
field_semantics.player_xy_resampled_m: Vendor 10 Hz XY tracking interpolated to 25 Hz. Series resampling flag is true even at source-aligned anchors.
field_semantics.exact_even_tracking_frame_alignment: pose_frame modulo 5 == 0; these exactly match even 10 Hz tracking frames.
field_semantics.pipeline_joint_interpolated: Always false: this adapter never fills gaps. It does not assert that upstream joint estimates were never smoothed or interpolated.
field_semantics.joints_pelvis_relative_m: Subtract the same-frame estimated midHip, retaining source axes. No anatomical pelvis orientation frame or world floor is invented.
field_semantics.ball_reconstructed_xyz_m: Unchanged upstream ball estimate; all xyz exhibit piecewise-linear 10 Hz-grid resampling in this pinned sample. No per-point error, calibrated center, spin, radius, or native 25 Hz measurement claim.
field_semantics.ball_is_detected: Vendor detection flag; it is not independent native 25 Hz observation evidence.
field_semantics.possession: Availability and equals-shooter masks preserve the older sample: shooter id is absent even during the newer vendor shot event.
field_semantics.relation_cosines: Dimensionless directed-vector relationships, not measured anatomical joint angles.
field_semantics.event_alignment: Matched vendor shot annotation at 10 Hz frame_end. Fractional 25 Hz frame and timestamp bracket retained; never a contact label.
field_semantics.event_time_to_impact: If present in source CSV, this is an opponent-pressure category, not foot-ball collision timing.

known_conflicts.action: Preserve source inconsistency; raw metadata unchanged.
Event identity comes from current official event CSV, not null pose possession.

limitations: This is broadcast-video reconstructed3D, not optical marker ground truth or robot-retargeted data.
Professional participation and vendor shot occurrence are supported; instep, kick side, maximal effort, support force and precise contact remain unknown.
z is not calibrated ground height; do not infer penetration, foot support, ball-foot distance in a shared vertical frame, or force.
Predicted extremity errors are large around this shot; valid geometry alone does not pass quality screening.
No original video, independent pose validation, anthropometric shape model, foot mesh, force plates, native rotations or collision labels acquired.
No velocity/acceleration or phase timing is derived in this small adapter; finite differencing would magnify uncertain 25 Hz estimates.
One continuous sample cannot establish population skill statistics or full-match robustness.
P2 is not complete; no model training, retargeting or controller replacement performed.
Repository reports approximately 97% player-identity accuracy overall; no independent framewise identity/video audit is supplied for this sample.
